finding: what is wrong, specifically, quoting the person's own note from the board
directive: what the re-spawned director must do differently. This is the only thing added to its inputs.

_reasonCodes.R-BRIEF: the brief misread the folder, or a conflict was resolved silently
_reasonCodes.R-REF: a reference is missing, wrong, or from a site the client did not name
_reasonCodes.R-SCRIPT: a scene, a line or the format
_reasonCodes.R-BOARD: a panel, the style, the continuity, or the sample
_reasonCodes.R-SHOT: a shot row, an id, a grouped label, an orphan
_reasonCodes.R-TEMPLATE: a budget or timeline cell, a sample date carried, a template changed
_reasonCodes.R-AUDIO: a VO, BGM or SFX row, or a source
_reasonCodes.R-REGISTER: a register row, unknown versus not applicable, a value typed by an agent
_reasonCodes.R-BREAKDOWN: a column, a continued row, a cell with no trace
_reasonCodes.R-CALLSHEET: shooting order, a day's rows, a call time, an overnight block, a conflict
